findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.linklyhq.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_links, list_webhooks, subscribe_webhook, list_link_webhooks, subscribe_link_webhook · Private data: export_clicks · Public sink: list_webhooks, subscribe_webhook, unsubscribe_webhook, list_link_webhooks, subscribe_link_webhook, unsubscribe_link_webhook · Destructive: batchDeleteLinks, delete_link, delete_domain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_links, list_webhooks, subscribe_webhook, list_link_webhooks, subscribe_link_webhook · Private data: export_clicks · Public sink: list_webhooks, subscribe_webhook, unsubscribe_webhook, list_link_webhooks, subscribe_link_webhook, unsubscribe_link_webhook · Destructive: batchDeleteLinks, delete_link, delete_domain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
